user.title: Vacuum Scheduler
user.description: Set up the Vacuum Scheduler hub. You will add rooms as subentries after setup.

global_config.title: Global Configuration
global_config.description: Configure global settings for the vacuum scheduler.

data_description.notify_entity: Optional notify entity for user notifications (e.g., notify.mobile_app_phone)
data_description.global_dry_run: When enabled, all cleaning operations are simulated without actually calling the vacuum
data_description.max_rooms_per_batch: Maximum number of rooms to clean in a single batch (1-20)
data_description.allow_cleaning_when_window_open: Allow cleaning even when window sensors report open
data_description.critical_overdue_days: Days beyond frequency before a room is considered critically overdue (1-7 days)

data_description.stabilization_period: Minimum time a door must be open before auto-triggering cleaning (0-30 minutes, 0 = immediate)

user.title: Add Room
user.description: Configure a room for automated vacuum scheduling.

data_description.room_name: A unique name for this room (e.g., 'Kitchen')
data_description.vacuum_entity: The vacuum entity to use for this room
data_description.door_sensor: Binary sensor that indicates when the room door is open
data_description.window_sensor: Binary sensor that indicates when a window is open
data_description.vacuum_frequency_days: How often to vacuum this room (1-30 days)
data_description.mop_frequency_days: How often to mop this room. Set to 0 to disable mopping. Mopping always includes vacuuming.
data_description.fan_speed: Fan speed preset from your vacuum's supported speeds (e.g., quiet, balanced, turbo)
data_description.time_window_start: Start of the time window when cleaning is allowed
data_description.time_window_end: End of the time window when cleaning is allowed

error.room_name_exists: A room with this name already exists.

evaluate_batch.name: Evaluate Batch
evaluate_batch.description: Evaluate all rooms and trigger cleaning for overdue rooms with open doors.

vacuum_entity.name: Vacuum Entity
vacuum_entity.description: Optional vacuum entity ID to filter rooms by.

dry_run.name: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If true, only return the list of rooms without triggering cleaning.

record_cleaning.name: Record Cleaning
record_cleaning.description: Manually record that a room has been cleaned.

room_name.name: Room Name
room_name.description: The name of the room that was cleaned.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Optional ISO format timestamp. Defaults to now.
